articles.title: Who is Michael Bradley Dow? The biological father of Sahara Rey's son, the model who died at age 34
articles.standfirst: The 38-year-old is reportedly named on baby Snow's birth certificate, revealing a detail the model had kept private
articles.summary: The 38-year-old is reportedly named on baby Snow's birth certificate, revealing a detail the model had kept private
articles.body:
Just nine months after welcoming her first child, Australian model and swimwear entrepreneur Sahara Ray died at 34, leaving behind a baby daughter whose father had remained largely unknown to the public.

Now, a new report has identified Michael Bradley Dow , 38, as the man listed on the birth certificate of Ray's daughter, Snow Ray Dow , providing one of the few publicly available details about the child's paternal family.

According to TMZ, which cited the birth certificate, Snow was born at 12:19 a.m. on January 27, 2026, at a Los Angeles hospital.

Ray , who previously attracted international attention through her modeling career and reported romance with Justin Bieber , had never publicly disclosed the identity of her daughter's father.

What is known about Michael Bradley Dow?

Despite the attention surrounding Ray 's death, little verified information has emerged about Dow beyond his name, age and identification on Snow 's birth certificate.

Ray had largely kept that aspect of her private life away from public attention, instead sharing occasional glimpses of motherhood with her social media followers.

In April, she introduced Snow on Instagram with a photograph accompanied by Bieber's song "Everything Hallelujah."

"Baby snow hallelujah," she wrote. Her final Instagram post, published in July, featured several photographs of her daughter and another affectionate message.

"My whole heart 🤍 baby Snow," Ray captioned the pictures.

Family remembers her following death at 34

Ray died at a Los Angeles hospital on Sunday, October 18, surrounded by loved ones, according to reports.

The Daily Mail reported that she suffered a suspected fentanyl overdose before being hospitalized and placed on life support. However, an official cause of death has not been released, and the circumstances remain unconfirmed.

Her mother, Gretchen Bach , remembered her daughter as someone whose life revolved around family, fashion and the ocean.

"Sahara was an incredibly passionate and kind young woman who loved her family, fashion, her daughter Snow, and surfing," Bach said in a statement.

"We're feeling the love that is pouring in from her cherished friends, fans and the many communities that she was part of around the world," she added.

Ray's younger sister, Ruby Ray , also honored her memory by sharing photographs from their lives together.

Final months focused on motherhood

The daughter of renowned surfer Tony Ray , Sahara established herself internationally as a model and swimwear designer before gradually withdrawing from the public spotlight.

In April 2024, she revealed that she had developed Guillain-Barré syndrome, a neurological condition that left her partially paralyzed and requiring a wheelchair.

Her daughter's arrival in January marked a significant new chapter in her life, with Ray's later social media posts reflecting her affection for Snow.

While Dow has now been identified in a reported birth record, details about his relationship with Ray remain private.

articles.title: Mark Twain, Writer: ”Never argue with stupid people, they will drag you down to their level and then beat you with experience"
articles.standfirst: Researchers have traced the popular saying to a surprising Hollywood connection dating back to 1956
articles.summary: Researchers have traced the popular saying to a surprising Hollywood connection dating back to 1956
articles.body:
Some disagreements are impossible to resolve, not because the facts are unclear, but because the people involved have little interest in changing their minds.

That's the idea behind a famous quotation widely attributed to Mark Twain , the American author whose observations about human behavior continue to resonate more than a century after his death.

"Never argue with stupid people, they will drag you down to their level and then beat you with experience," Twain apparently said.

The message suggests that engaging with someone unwilling to reason can become an exhausting exercise, allowing the argument to deteriorate until the original point is forgotten.

articles.title: Raw and Unfiltered: Late Actor Eric Dane Opens Up About ALS and Addiction in Final Memoir
articles.standfirst: The actor from "Grey's Anatomy" and "Euphoria", who died at 53, recounts in his autobiography how he lost the ability to hug his daughters and looks back on the years in which he used all kinds of drugs
articles.summary: The actor from "Grey's Anatomy" and "Euphoria", who died at 53, recounts in his autobiography how he lost the ability to hug his daughters and looks back on the years in which he used all kinds of drugs
articles.body:
Actor Eric Dane , known for playing Dr. Mark Sloan on " Grey's Anatomy " and Cal Jacobs on " Euphoria ," left behind his most personal experiences in writing before dying last February 19 at the age of 53, after battling amyotrophic lateral sclerosis ( ALS ). In his posthumous memoir, titled "My Book of Days: A Memoir in Moments", the American actor reflects on the impact of the illness, his struggles with addiction, and the most difficult moments in his relationship with his two daughters.

'The American magazine People has exclusively previewed several excerpts from "My Book of Days: A Memoir in Moments", which will arrive in bookstores next November 3. In the book, Eric recalls episodes that reflect the physical deterioration caused by ALS and the consequences it had on his daily life, while also candidly addressing a period marked by drug use.'

The day his daughter had to help him out of the water

One of the most distressing episodes the actor recounts occurred during a family vacation in Mexico, after receiving the ALS diagnosis. While he was in the water, he realized that he had lost the strength needed to swim and that he could not get out on his own. His young daughter, Georgia, along with a friend, had to help him get to safety.

'After the incident, Eric asked for his phone and called Rebecca Gayheart, his wife, from whom he had been separated for years, although the two maintained a close family relationship. " What happened? " she asked him. " I can't swim, Rebecca. I can't swim ," he replied. Both broke down in tears as they understood the seriousness of what had happened. Rebecca then confessed to him that she had long feared that moment would come.'

The disease also affected his ability to perform everyday gestures that had previously been part of his relationship with his daughters. One of the most painful memories he recounts in the book took place in December, when he attended a performance of "The Nutcracker" in which his eldest daughter, Billie, was taking part.

I wish I could hug you. I can no longer raise my arms

After the performances, father and daughter used to hug each other. However, the progression of the disease had reduced Eric's mobility so much that he could no longer wrap her in his arms. " Billie, I'm so sorry. I'm so very sorry that I can't wrap my arms around you. I wish I could hug you. I can no longer lift my arms ," he told his daughter, who was 15 at the time.

In his memoir, the actor recounts how both of them burst into tears while she remained kneeling and hugging him. Despite the pain, Eric found beauty in that moment and in the possibility of transforming his way of expressing affection. " This moment, my daughter hugging me, my arms and hands lifeless, both of us crying, is incredibly beautiful, and I think maybe we need to start a new tradition ," he wrote. The young woman ended up wiping her face and whispering to him: " I love you, Dad ."

In another passage, the actor sums up his way of facing the illness with a reflection: " This disease is slowly destroying my body, but it will never take my spirit ." Eric died two months after that episode, surrounded by his loved ones, according to a statement from his family, which highlighted that his daughters, Billie and Georgia, were the center of his world.

His drug addiction during the Hollywood years

The memoirs also address a stage of the actor's youth marked by drug use. Before achieving fame, Eric went through a period he describes as his " dark period ," in which the difficulties in landing roles coincided with a severe drug addiction. " I did some auditions and got some roles, but above all, I was doing drugs ," he admits in the book. The actor lists a long range of substances he came to use, including alcohol, marijuana, heroin, cocaine, methamphetamine, crack, and various painkillers, as well as medications such as Xanax, Valium, Vicodin, and OxyContin.

His career began to take off in 2005, when he landed the role of plastic surgeon Mark Sloan in "Grey's Anatomy." The series made him one of the most recognizable faces on television, although professional success did not put an end to his addiction problems. Eric recounts that he suffered a relapse around 2008, after injuring a cervical disc while exercising. The pain led him back to painkillers and worsened his dependency. At that time, his physical condition deteriorated considerably: " My body goes to shit. I drop down to 77 kilos, my face sinks in, the light goes out of my eyes, and I look gaunt. Fuck, I look like a drug addict. It shows. I can tell too ."

The California actor also acknowledges that his addiction affected his emotional state and his relationship with others. " I’m no longer the cheerful, funny guy, the one who is always making everyone else laugh ," he explains before describing a period in which he tended to isolate himself and suffer in silence. During the filming of "Grey’s Anatomy," he was admitted to rehabilitation centers five times. Over time, he managed to stay sober while working and move forward in his recovery, although he admitted that the consequences of that period continued to affect him.

With "My Book of Days: A Memoir in Moments," Eric Dane leaves a personal testimony about addiction, illness, and the bond with his daughters, three fundamental aspects of a life he wanted to recount candidly before his death.

articles.title: Cause of Sahara Ray's death: what is known about the final hours of Justin Bieber's ex-girlfriend at 34 years old
articles.standfirst: The Australian model died at the age of 34 after being admitted to a Los Angeles hospital. According to several U.S. media outlets, she is believed to have suffered a fentanyl overdose, although the official cause of her death has not yet been confirmed.
articles.summary: The Australian model died at the age of 34 after being admitted to a Los Angeles hospital. According to several U.S. media outlets, she is believed to have suffered a fentanyl overdose, although the official cause of her death has not yet been confirmed.
articles.body:
Sahara Ray, the Australian model and designer who rose to fame because of her relationship with Justin Bieber, died on Sunday, October 18 at the age of 34 . Her family confirmed the news and explained that she passed away in a hospital, surrounded by her loved ones.

Reports about her final hours point to an incident that occurred on Friday, October 16, when she allegedly suffered a suspected fentanyl overdose and was rushed to a Los Angeles hospital. According to sources cited by Page Six and Daily Mail, her condition was critical and she remained on life support before her family made a difficult decision.

What is known about Sahara Ray's final hours

The model's family had reportedly decided to withdraw life support on Sunday after her condition worsened; however, it should be noted that this information has not been confirmed by those close to her.

The alleged fentanyl overdose is, for now, the explanation circulated by U.S. media outlets citing sources close to the case. The official cause of death has not been announced, nor has it been clarified whether the alleged use was accidental or intentional.

Sahara Ray had spoken about her health problems

In 2024, the model said that she was suffering from Guillain-Barré syndrome, a neurological disease that can cause muscle weakness and paralysis. As she explained at the time, the condition appeared after she was involved in a traffic accident that seriously affected her health and mobility.

Ray had also spoken publicly about her personal difficulties and her admission to a treatment center in 2021 to receive help for issues related to drug and alcohol use.

Her relationship with Justin Bieber and her daughter Snow

Sahara Ray gained international notoriety in 2016, when she was photographed alongside Justin Bieber during a vacation in Hawaii.

The images fueled rumors about a romantic relationship between the two, although the singer had not been at the center of the model's public life in recent years.

In January 2026, Ray became the mother of a girl named Snow. Months later, she shared photographs of her daughter on Instagram with a loving message.

Her death, at the age of 34, leaves the little girl in the care of her family, while questions continue about the circumstances of the model's death.

The family has confirmed the death, but has not made an official cause public.
